description: Every model, in any Lean universe, of an existential–universal sentence over the finite relational presentation yields a labelled table model of some size \(1\le d\le\max(1,m+c)\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ExistentialUniversalSentences.bounded_table_model.{u_1} (c : ℕ) (arities : List ℕ)
  {M : Type u_1} [(Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ExistentialUniversalSentences.lang c arities).Structure M] [Nonempty M]
  {m n : ℕ}
  (φ : (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ExistentialUniversalSentences.lang c arities).BoundedFormula Empty (m + n))
  (hq : φ.IsQF) (hφ : M ⊨ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ExistentialUniversalSentences.sentence c arities φ) :
  ∃ d < max 1 (m + c), ∃ T, Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ExistentialUniversalSentences.accepts c arities T φ = true
